wrong_route.revision_strategy: Reclassify the task and recompile; preserve explicit user locks.

lost_parameter_lock.revision_strategy: Restate only the missing lock near the top and preservation section.

identity_drift.revision_strategy: Strengthen identity role/mode; remove style language that implicitly redesigns the face.

reference_role_leakage.revision_strategy: Explicitly forbid imported attributes outside each reference role.

historical_anachronism.revision_strategy: Replace only the offending element with a compatible alternative or relabel the result as an intentional hybrid.

mixed_culture.revision_strategy: Select one primary cultural system and keep any cross-cultural element explicit and localized.

art_method_failure.revision_strategy: Add fabrication/mark-making/edge behavior; remove generic style adjectives.

material_failure.revision_strategy: Specify physical surface/light/fracture/patina/glaze/thread behavior tied to the material.

pose_mechanics_failure.revision_strategy: Simplify limb assignments and restate support/weight/hand contact.

lighting_conflict.revision_strategy: Choose one motivated key source and subordinate fills/effects.

composition_failure.revision_strategy: Preserve subject/style; restate spatial layers, camera position and negative space.

over_constrained_prompt.revision_strategy: Delete low-signal duplicate constraints and keep only causal visual anchors.

image_model_limitation.revision_strategy: Reduce complexity, split into stages, or use edit iterations instead of adding prose.

artifact_form_failure.revision_strategy: Restate object geometry and medium-specific structural constraints without changing unrelated style.

artifact_state_failure.revision_strategy: Change only age/conservation/damage cues so the surface matches the requested lifecycle state.

hand_prop_interaction_failure.revision_strategy: Restate which hand contacts which object and how weight/contact forces work; simplify if needed.

unsupported_historical_certainty.revision_strategy: Downgrade wording to plausible/interpretive/unknown or replace with stronger evidence; do not call it authentic.

survival_bias_confusion.revision_strategy: Separate reconstructed in-period appearance from surviving, excavated, weathered, or conserved appearance.

evidence_retrieval_failure.revision_strategy: Repair routing/indexing so the relevant claim set is loaded before changing prompt prose.

source_conflict.revision_strategy: Preserve competing interpretations and choose a bounded visual option explicitly; do not silently merge them.

weak_evidence_promoted_to_canonical.revision_strategy: Restore the claim’s actual confidence/compatibility label and qualify the compiled wording.

gallery_metadata_failure.revision_strategy: Repair case/asset provenance metadata before publishing; do not infer missing license rights.

regression_baseline_drift.revision_strategy: Inspect semantic/evidence/prompt diffs and accept a new baseline only after the behavior change is intentional and reviewed.
